summary: Personal Management System is an open-source personal dashboard designed to help you consolidate daily organisation tasks. It provides a centralised space for routine requirements such as to-do lists, note-taking, payment tracking, and schedule management.
goodFor: It suits individuals looking for a self-hosted, MIT-licensed dashboard to manage everyday life admin without relying on proprietary cloud services.
watchOut: Given the broad scope of a general personal dashboard, it may overlap with dedicated single-purpose applications while lacking deep specialised features in areas like financial accounting or advanced note-taking.
deployNotes: As a containerised application distributed via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
